script_text: Pisces, this week is not a drift; it is Neptune turning your water into a decision. Monday and Tuesday, the 4th House New Moon in Gemini joins Mercury’s station direct, while Mars in the 7th opposes Saturn in the 1st, so a partner or client can feel rigid. Wednesday is the turn: Mercury is direct in the 4th, clearing family tension. Thursday, Jupiter in the 5th trines Neptune in the 12th, making romance and art magnetic. For love, choose one vulnerable sentence; for career and money, Venus in the 4th sextiles Mars in the 7th, sealing a remote-work or real estate deal. Saturday is sweet, but Uranus in the 4th square Jupiter in the 5th can flip plans. Best day: Monday, because the 4th House New Moon resets your base. Worst day: Tuesday, because Mars opposite Saturn strains deals. Keep receipts. Follow for daily updates.
